name: comp-508
title: Two Month Range Calendar
description: One bordered dark panel holding November and December one above the other, each with its own weekday row. A single range runs from a day in the first month to a day in the second, both ends circled in white.
use: Ranges regularly cross a month boundary, so seeing two months saves arrow clicks.
avoid: The months stack in one narrow column, so the panel grows tall and the type becomes tiny.
a11y: Days are buttons in labelled grids and month changes are announced politely, but nothing explains the two-click range rule. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A narrow black panel with two month blocks divided by a faint gap: each has a centred month name, a row of two-letter weekdays and five or six rows of day numbers. Days in the range sit in grey cells and the two ends are solid white circles.
behaves: Pressing a day starts the range and moving into the next month previews the span; a second press fixes the end, and the arrows move both months together. The frames move the end from 9 December to 23 and back to 10.
customise: The opening range of today plus twenty-five days and the caption link sit in the file; month count, paged navigation and outside days come from the shared calendar.
weight: light: Two month grids of plain date buttons; nothing animates.
